courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write tests below the marked line in the editor. Run checks the correct implementation and a sample of the faulty versions. Submit checks every version. Keep the supplied code and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

This target and its tests are an offline recreation from the public description. The original code and template require Pybites premium.

The offline runner supports `pytest.raises` with `match`, `pytest.mark.parametrize`, function and yield fixtures, numeric `pytest.approx`, `pytest.fail`, `capsys`, `capfd`, `monkeypatch`, and `tmp_path`. `unittest.mock.patch` also works. Use top-level test functions and function-scoped fixtures. Async tests, pytest classes with setup hooks, plugins, skip/xfail, and advanced fixture scopes are not supported.

This course measures statement coverage with Python tracing and checks explicit faulty variants. It does not run pytest-cov or mutatest. `SURVIVED` names a fault that your tests did not detect.

[Original Pybites exercise](https://pybitesplatform.com/bites/write-tests-for-list_to_decimal/)
